subject.title: [Feature]: Ali bailian coding plan support ( thinking/reasoning enabled )

question: Should OpenClaw officially enable Ali Bailian/Qwen Coding Plan reasoning through bundled Qwen catalog metadata, custom bailian provider inference, or both, and for which verified model/region set?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent support boundary depends on vendor/model proof and on whether maintainers want separate partial PRs or one consolidated provider change.

options.title: Land Verified Slices
options.body: Review the open custom-provider and catalog PRs as separate verified slices, then close this issue only after merged coverage or an explicit documented remainder.

options.title: Request One Consolidated Fix
options.body: Ask contributors to combine bundled catalog metadata, custom-provider inference, docs, and tests into one Qwen-provider PR after vendor verification.

options.title: Defer Broad Enablement
options.body: Keep current conservative behavior and require stronger model-by-model Alibaba proof before changing bundled Coding Plan reasoning flags.

recommendation.title: Land Verified Slices
recommendation.body: Review the open custom-provider and catalog PRs as separate verified slices, then close this issue only after merged coverage or an explicit documented remainder.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the Qwen provider surface and already routed this issue toward a provider-owned maintainer decision.
